title: Heavy and Light
short: Tell which is heavier or lighter, and read a balance.

blocks.html: Some things are heavy and some are light. A pumpkin is heavy. A leaf is light. A balance helps: the heavy side goes down.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: The pumpkin side went down. The pumpkin is heavier.

blocks.html: On a balance, the heavier side goes down.

For the grown-up: Let your child hold two things, one in each hand, and say which is heavier. A hanger with two cups on strings makes a simple balance. Bigger is not always heavier: try a balloon and a rock. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Hold a book and a feather: which is heavier?
Make a hanger balance with two cups.
Carry the light bag and the heavy bag.
